protocol.root_selection: For each exact saved center/role, geometry_consistent trace accepted roots: independent closure, original bounds, unique passive geometry branch identical to saved center. Nearest full12 Euclidean distance, branch ascending tie; no collision filtering or center replacement.
protocol.downstream_policy: Same selected branch for both numerical variants. Each local endpoint must independently pass closure/branch/bounds/aligned discrete collision before its source RBS. Source true permits reconstruct; source false retained. No branch/h replacement. Path node reuse requires exact q and previously qualified call record.
protocol.trace_equivalence: Compare logical original returned/q12/path_q12/status/request/environment only; trace instrumentation/count/native observations excluded. Exact parsed-number equality. Trace first, then plain, same process-isolated request.
protocol.failure_policy: Corrected success with wrong closure/nativeFK/active-coordinate/branch is soundness stop. Source-native unsound success retained and excluded from downstream. Bound/collision is ordinary rejection. Cap/runtime/unknown/source-equivalence mismatch stops, saves prefix/unexecuted fixed templates; no retry.
protocol.scope: No random sampler, planner allocation/solve, RSS, new formal statistics, collision-positive control rerun or VI B charge. Existing source mesh pairs/8mm tolerance/ABB collinear rod policy; no full physical geometry/CCD certificate.
protocol.plain_accounting: Internal plain calls are unobserved; logical requests and child CPU/wall measured, no fabricated inner counts. Trace counters exclude constructor; all post-top-level native FK observations counted.
protocol.deduplication: No dedup of captured successful projection events; every event gets2 math FK+1 adapter(4 internal armFK/J,2 source variant queries). Path only reuses exact previously checked nodes; no hidden new FK. Four centers get same gates once;8 negatives get math only.
